_doc: STT-family fanout (units stt_on_stt, stt_on_recon, stt_on_amulet; NOT stt_on_spt, whose gem5-spt build declassifies): standard enumeration + fanout v2 (Anna 2026-11-08, FV-1 = edge splices + read-only fillers, FV-2 = random edge subset biased to the transmitter). Copy 'fanout_v2' and 'reg_naming' into a run config; pipeline.py passes them to batch_generate.py --fanout-v2-config / --reg-naming-config. Splices are value-preserving ALU ops on Alloy rf edges (parsexml.py FV2_SPLICE_OPS); fillers read live registers and write only registers the program never uses (FV2_FILLER_OPS). pre_window_reads=true is allowed for STT (no declassification by reading; MODEL_AUDIT_SPT_RECON.md rules 4, 11); keep it false for SPT (rule 9). Off for SPT/ReCon units until Anna signs off FV-3/FV-6. Design: wiki/design/VOCAB_TABLES.md 'Fanout v2'.
